sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Read

The Bible teaches that those who followed Jesus witnessed His death and resurrection. Their lives were changed forever. Jesus gathered them together and told them His work on earth was finished. Now it was time for them to go to work! Jesus told them He would send the Spirit of God from heaven to work in and through them.

After Jesus’ return to heaven, the Spirit of God came to dwell in the hearts of His followers. Filled with the power and wisdom of God, Jesus’ followers began to tell people everywhere about what Jesus had done. They told people about how they could have a right relationship with God. Those who believed were baptized. They gathered together and were called church.
Let’s read some verses from the Holy Scriptures, the Bible, that relate to this story.
Acts 1:1–11
Teach

This scripture teaches that God's grace is poured out on all people. On the day of Pentecost, God poured out His Spirit — on young and old, on sons and daughters, even on the lowliest of servants. We could never earn or buy the Holy Spirit. He is the gift of the exalted Jesus Christ. This gift is for everyone who believes in the Lord Jesus.
Ask
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little — how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Make a Plan

The Holy Spirit healed every social division and created a new family of faith. The family is called the Church. The word Church simply means a gathering. As you continue to meet regularly, let the Holy Spirit to guide your life as He guided the first church.
Begin sharing the gospel with your family and friends!
To whom will you tell Jesus’ story?
Practice sharing Jesus’ Story one at a time.
Pray
Ask the Holy Spirit to guide us as me meet together and to help us share the story of Jesus with others.
